branchFacts.parser: AI-SDK object parse/schema validation happens after the SDK retry wrapper. Client fallback parseJsonLoose and Zod validation add no provider fetch by themselves.
branchFacts.ordinaryMasked400: After a masked/compiled structured failure, ordinary runtime may call prompt-JSON fallback and then one JSON repair continuation; if still invalid, the application loop retries.
branchFacts.researchMasked400: At question-generation-llm.ts lines 411-417, an active research runtime continues/throws within the strict structured path and never calls prompt-JSON fallback.
branchFacts.candidateRepair: At most one full-schema repair wrapper is attempted per returned candidate in each pass, subject to blocking-code and deadline predicates.
branchFacts.grammarSolver: Strict and relaxed GRAMMAR_ERROR candidates that pass deterministic gates receive one STANDARD-plan solver wrapper; scarce/salvage mode omits it.
branchFacts.premiumLadder: Eligible PREMIUM GRAMMAR_ERROR strict passes can exhaust the nine-stage ladder and then fall through to legacy generation, candidate repair, and solver in the same pass.
branchFacts.salvage: STANDARD can add relaxed plus grammar-scarce/universal salvage passes; PREMIUM skips relaxed and can add grammar-scarce/universal salvage. Pool admission itself is zero-provider, but a conservative empty/non-relaxable pool permits the generation passes.
branchFacts.masked400SdkRetry: HTTP/masked 400 itself is non-retryable in the installed SDK, but a conservative SDK operation can have earlier retryable failures before its final masked-400 result.
